description_en: Updates the description, context token limit, maximum output token count, or capability configuration of a specified model
description_zh: 更新指定模型的描述、上下文 Token 上限、最大输出 Token 数或能力配置
kebab_example: aliyun agentcore update-model --workspace-id ws-1 --model-id model-1 --region cn-hangzhou
name: UpdateModel

fields.help_en: The model description. The maximum length is 255 characters after leading and trailing whitespace is removed. Pass an empty string to clear the description. If this parameter is not provided or set to null, the original value is retained. Modifying only the description does not refresh the model configuration of associated agents
fields.help_zh: 模型描述，去除首尾空白后最长 255 个字符。传入空字符串可清空描述；不传该参数或传入 null 时保留原值。仅修改描述不会刷新关联 Agent 的模型配置
fields.name: description

parameters.help_en: The request body for updating the model. At least one non-null parameter must be provided among description, contextSize, maxTokens, and capabilities
parameters.help_zh: 模型更新请求体。description、contextSize、maxTokens 和 capabilities 中至少传入一个非 null 参数
parameters.name: body

parameters.help_en: The client token for idempotence. Not supported
parameters.help_zh: 幂等使用的客户端令牌。暂不支持
parameters.name: client_token

schema.description_en: The result of the model update request
schema.description_zh: 模型更新请求的处理结果

code.description_en: The business status code. The value SUCCESS indicates success
code.description_zh: 业务状态码。成功时为 SUCCESS

audio.description_en: Indicates whether the model supports audio input or output
audio.description_zh: 模型是否支持音频输入或输出

document.description_en: Indicates whether the model supports document input
document.description_zh: 模型是否支持文档输入

multiToolCall.description_en: Indicates whether the model is able to invoke multiple tool calls in a single response
multiToolCall.description_zh: 模型是否支持在一次响应中发起多个工具调用

reasoning.description_en: Indicates whether the model supports reasoning
reasoning.description_zh: 模型是否支持推理能力

streamToolCall.description_en: Indicates whether the model supports streaming tool calling
streamToolCall.description_zh: 模型是否支持流式工具调用

toolCall.description_en: Indicates whether the model supports tool calling
toolCall.description_zh: 模型是否支持工具调用

video.description_en: Indicates whether the model supports video input
video.description_zh: 模型是否支持视频输入

vision.description_en: Indicates whether the model supports image input
vision.description_zh: 模型是否支持图像输入

contextSize.description_en: The context window size of the model, in tokens. The value must be a positive integer
contextSize.description_zh: 模型上下文窗口大小，单位为 Token，必须为正整数

createdAt.description_en: The time when the resource was created, in RFC 3339 UTC format
createdAt.description_zh: 资源创建时间，采用 RFC 3339 UTC 格式

description.description_en: The model description. The maximum length is 255 characters
description.description_zh: 模型描述，最长 255 个字符

maxTokens.description_en: The maximum number of output tokens supported per generation by the model
maxTokens.description_zh: 模型单次生成支持的最大输出 Token 数
maxTokens.title_en: 模型单次生成支持的最大输出 Token 数
maxTokens.title_zh: 模型单次生成支持的最大输出 Token 数

updatedAt.description_en: The time when the resource was last updated, in RFC 3339 UTC format
updatedAt.description_zh: 资源最后更新时间，采用 RFC 3339 UTC 格式

httpStatusCode.description_en: The HTTP status code. The value 200 indicates success

message.description_en: The result message of the request

success.description_en: Indicates whether the request was successful
